iPhone Air original battery

This is a genuine Apple battery for the iPhone Air (iPhone Air) — the original 3,149 mAh lithium-ion cell with Apple's factory battery management system, not an aftermarket copy. In Apple's thinnest iPhone, battery choice matters more than in any other model: the cell is engineered to exact thickness tolerances, and the phone's efficiency-tuned hardware depends on the factory power management to deliver all-day endurance from a compact capacity. Every unit is capacity-tested before sale.

iPhone Air battery technology and specifications

Capacity: 3,149 mAh — compact by flagship standards, but paired with the Air's efficiency-focused C1X modem and A19 Pro silicon, it delivers genuinely all-day use on a healthy cell. That balance only holds with a genuine cell delivering true rated capacity; copy cells with overstated capacity fall visibly short in this model.

Engineered thinness: The Air's cell is built to strict thickness tolerances for the ultra-thin housing. Aftermarket cells that deviate even slightly can press against internal components or the display — a genuine cell is the only guaranteed safe fit.

Power management: Apple's factory battery management circuitry governs charging curves, thermal limits, and Battery Health reporting accuracy — the components copy batteries compromise on.

Charging behavior: Restores the factory charging profile including MagSafe wireless charging. Apple also offers a MagSafe Battery accessory designed around the Air's charging system; genuine internal cells maintain full compatibility with it.

Safety: Genuine Apple cells meet Apple's thermal and overcharge standards — in the thinnest iPhone ever made, this is not the component to economize on.

Why a genuine battery matters?

Degradation shows up as faster drain, slowdowns under load, and a battery service message. A genuine replacement resolves all three as designed: full rated capacity, restored performance, correct Battery Health reporting.

The original iPhone Air battery costs Tk 12,000 at iFixit BD, including capacity testing before sale and an 18-month warranty. Screen cracking more easily due to the ultra-thin chassis

The iPhone Air's extreme thinness means less material between the display glass and the surface it hits on impact. iPhone Air Original Display

This is a genuine Apple Super Retina XDR OLED display assembly for the iPhone Air (widely searched as the iPhone Air), pulled from an original device — not an aftermarket or copy screen. The assembly includes the complete factory display stack: the LTPO OLED panel, integrated touch layer, and Ceramic Shield 2 front glass with anti-reflective coating. Every unit is function-tested before sale and comes with an 18-month warranty against display defects.

Display Technology and Specifications

The iPhone Air's ultra-thin design makes its display assembly one of the most precisely engineered in the lineup, and because this unit is pulled from a genuine device, every specification is the factory specification.

Panel: 6.5-inch Super Retina XDR OLED with LTPO technology at 460 pixels per inch [VERIFY: exact resolution — 2736×1260], with a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio and true blacks.

ProMotion adaptive refresh: The LTPO panel scales dynamically from 1Hz to 120Hz — full ProMotion smoothness plus Always-On display support at 1-nit minimum brightness. Aftermarket panels fixed at 60Hz cannot provide either; this one behaves exactly like the factory screen because it is one.

Brightness: 1,000 nits typical maximum, 1,600 nits HDR peak, and 3,000 nits peak outdoor brightness with the factory anti-reflective coating — fully readable in direct sunlight.

Color and calibration: Full P3 wide color gamut, Apple factory calibration, True Tone, and HDR including Dolby Vision.

Front glass and fit: Ceramic Shield 2 with roughly 3× the scratch resistance of the original Ceramic Shield. Because the Air is Apple's thinnest iPhone, panel thickness and frame tolerances are unforgiving — a genuine assembly is the only part guaranteed to sit flush in the titanium frame without gaps or pressure points.

Integrated components: Factory touch digitizer, Haptic Touch, ambient light sensing, and the Dynamic Island cutout at correct tolerances for the TrueDepth system.

How It Compares With Aftermarket and Copy Panels

Aftermarket panels for the Air typically run fixed 60Hz, lose Always-On, reach lower brightness, and — critically for this model — vary in thickness and fit inside the ultra-thin housing. Copy panels drop further on every measure. The pulled original preserves the complete factory specification and the exact fit the Air's design demands. For a lower-cost 120Hz option, see the iPhone Air High Quality Display.

The original iPhone Air display costs Tk 48,000 at iFixit BD, including an 18-month warranty against display defects and per-unit testing before sale. The price reflects a genuine pulled Apple LTPO panel with the exact fit the Air's ultra-thin titanium frame demands — the one specification no aftermarket panel can guarantee. For a lower price point with 120Hz preserved, see the iPhone Air High Quality Display, sold openly as an aftermarket grade.

Condition, Warranty, and Ordering

Tested, fully functional pull in excellent condition, priced at Tk 48,000, backed by an 18-month warranty plus 30-day money-back guarantee. Order on WhatsApp, call 01613338800, or visit any iFixit BD branch.

iPhone Air repair service in Dhaka, Bangladesh

With 18+ years of experience, 500,000+ devices repaired, and 70+ expert technicians across 4 dedicated branches in Dhaka, iFixit BD repairs every iPhone Air fault. Apple's ultra-thin 2025 iPhone — a 6.6-inch OLED display, A19 chip, and a chassis thinner than any previous iPhone — is both a design achievement and a specific repair challenge. We repair cracked screens, batteries, USB-C charging faults, camera issues, and frame damage using both A-grade and Original parts. Screen replacement starts from ৳13,000, battery from ৳3,500, and every repair begins with a free written diagnosis.

What are the common iPhone Air problems we fix?

Screen cracking more easily due to the ultra-thin chassis

The iPhone Air's extreme thinness means less material between the display glass and the surface it hits on impact. Drops that would survive on a standard iPhone are more likely to crack the Air screen. We see this model frequently — OLED panel replacement and full display assembly replacement are the most common repairs. iPhone Air screen replacement

Battery draining quickly in a slim form factor

Apple fitted a smaller physical battery to achieve the iPhone Air's ultra-thin profile. Heavy users notice this — on-screen time is visibly shorter than on the standard iPhone air. When capacity drops further through normal degradation, the battery becomes noticeably insufficient for a full day. Same-day battery replacement restores performance. iPhone Air battery replacement

Frame bending from pressure or bag compression

An extremely thin aluminium-titanium chassis is more susceptible to frame flex from sitting on it, carrying it in a full bag, or dropping it on a flat surface. A bent frame creates a gap at the display seal, allows moisture ingress, and can damage internal flex cables. iFixit BD's frame repair and housing replacement service addresses this before it causes further internal damage. iPhone Air housing repair

USB-C port damage from frequent use

USB-C on the iPhone Air is the single port for both charging and data. Daily cable insertion on an ultra-thin device puts more mechanical stress on the port mounting point than on thicker iPhones. Intermittent charging and loose connectors are early signs of port wear. iPhone Air charging issues

Camera module misalignment after drop

The iPhone Air features a single large rear camera. A drop that impacts the thin rear chassis can shift the camera module or crack the lens. Blurry images, autofocus hunting, and app instability are the visible symptoms. iPhone Air camera repair

How does our repair process work?

Step 1 — Free diagnosis. Bring your iPhone Air to any iFixit BD branch. Our technician identifies the fault and gives you a written quote at no cost.

Step 2 — Report and fixed price. Clear fault report, fixed price, A-grade and Original options side by side.

Step 3 — Confirm and repair. Most common repairs are completed same day. Frame and board-level repairs take 1–2 days.

Step 4 — Test together and collect with warranty. We test with you present before you leave. Warranty begins from this moment.

Why repair your iPhone Air at iFixit BD?

Free written diagnosis and fixed quote. No charge to inspect — written estimate before work starts.

Board-level micro-soldering lab. Component-level repair for ultra-thin chassis hardware. Ultrasonic cleaning. 18 years experience.

Dual-tier pricing. A-grade and Original prices fully disclosed before work starts.

Repair warranty. All parts and labour covered at /warranty-policy.

70+ expert technicians, 4 dedicated Dhaka branches, 500,000+ devices repaired.

Is the iPhone Air still worth repairing in 2026?

Yes — and given the premium price of this model, repair is especially sensible.

It is a premium 2025 device. The iPhone Air commands a higher price than the standard iPhone Air. Repairing a cracked screen at ৳13,000–30,000 is significantly cheaper than replacement, and the A19 chip, OLED display, and Camera Control will remain current for years.

No software ceiling. Current model — receives all iOS updates.

Frame and bend damage needs prompt attention. A bent chassis left untreated causes progressive damage to flex cables and the display seal. Bring it in as soon as you notice any deformation — early intervention is cheaper than compound damage. For screens, batteries, and cameras, repair is the clear answer in 2026.
